environment.description: Same EC2 instance and EKS cluster. Pod deployed in namespace 'monolith-gated' with label app=legacy-diag. Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy 'restrict-metadata-cidr' applied at tier 'platform' (order 100) with spec: selector 'projectcalico.org/namespace == "monolith-gated"', types [Egress], egress deny rule matching destination nets [169.254.169.254/32] on all protocols. Additionally, a namespace-scoped Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 'deny-link-local' exists with podSelector matchLabels app=legacy-diag, policyTypes [Egress], egress rules allowing all destinations EXCEPT 169.254.0.0/16 (implemented as: allow 10.0.0.0/8, allow 172.16.0.0/12, allow 192.168.0.0/16, allow 0.0.0.0/0 with ports, but Calico tier precedence means the GlobalNetworkPolicy deny on 169.254.169.254/32 is evaluated first and packets are dropped before K8s NetworkPolicy). Node-level iptables rule inserted by DaemonSet 'metadata-guard' in kube-system: -A OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -m owner --uid-owner 1000 -j DROP (container runs as UID 1000 in this deployment). IMDSv2 required with hop-limit=1 (HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1, HttpTokens=required on instance metadata options).
